353:t_2:97.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Now that it's decided, I'm not going to keep wearing a plugsuit forever. I'll have them get me a change of clothes.」

353:t_2:98.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Just so you know, the whole 'many years have passed since then' thing is a hassle, so there's no need to explain it.」

353:t_2:99.en:
$$マリ$$
「The curse of the EVA, huh...」

353:t_2:100.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We're just guests in this world. So... I have no intention of getting any more involved with them than necessary.」

353:t_2:101.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I see... You're a kind girl, aren't you.」

353:t_2:103.en:
$$マリ$$
「Prin-cess. You've figured out that's just how this kid is, so don't bother engaging with him.」

353:t_2:106.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Brat $$シンジ$$, a knockoff teacher's pet, and a goofball...! Just thinking about what's ahead gives me a headache...!」

353:t_2:107.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Where am I supposed to go... and what am I supposed to do...)

353:t_2:109.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Father, $$ミサト$$, $$カヲル$$... Tell me... somebody...)

353:t_2:114.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(...There are no traces of intrusion in $$ヴェーダ$$'s system. I suppose even the $$サイデリアル$$ couldn't analyze the system in such a short time...)

353:t_2:115.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s founder, $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$...)

353:t_2:116.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(He foresaw the existence of the $$イノベイター$$s and prepared the GN Particles and $$イノベイド$$s that spur their awakening. He is clearly connected to $$クロノ$$...)

353:t_2:117.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(The data in the deepest part of this $$ヴェーダ$$ must be his true intent and the truth about $$クロノ$$...)

353:t_2:118.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I can't access it yet... But someday, without fail, I will reach it.)

353:t_2:119.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(That is my role: helping the $$イノベイター$$s... helping $$刹那$$.)

353:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems you've finished your talk, $$アスカ$$.」

353:t_10:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「AG, huh... Still as overly familiar as ever.」

353:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「First, allow me to celebrate your recovery, $$アスカ$$. I... always believed we would surely meet again.」

353:t_10:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Recovery, huh... If you really think I'm back to how I was, you're pretty carefree.」

353:t_10:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Want me to show you what's under it?」

353:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is a saying: 'Hidden, it is the flower; unhidden, it is no flower...' So I must respectfully decline.」

353:t_10:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You're still as glib as ever.」

353:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you are much the same, $$アスカ$$. For all the trash you talked about $$シンジ$$ out loud...」

353:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When the four EVAs shot down the enemy, did a warm feeling not well up in your heart?」

353:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Denying it is pointless. I shall add the $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z that you produced to the unit's stock.」

353:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'Hidden, it is the flower,' as they say. I have no intention of revealing what lies at the bottom of your heart to anyone, so please rest assured.」

353:t_10:23.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Don't be so wary. From now on we're comrades who will be working together, after all.」

353:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For my part, I have no intention of causing any needless trouble, but...」

353:t_10:25.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I think that's for the best. Interfering too much in events is dangerous.」

353:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Coming from you, that doesn't sound very convincing...」

353:t_10:27.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Sorry. Then I'll make it up to you in some fitting way.」

353:t_10:28.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Well then, let's give it our all again today... business, business. ...Was that all right?」

353:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You did my catchphrase, and I never even taught it to you!」

353:t_10:30.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I may not know as much as you do, but I know a few things myself...」

354:t_001:0.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「The deep-space mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...」

354:t_001:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「They aren't even using optical camouflage... Did they not anticipate our approach...?」

354:t_001:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$'s main body is in there.」

354:t_001:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now that we've come this far, there's only one thing to do. Let's hurry on in and take it back quick.」

354:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're really fired up, $$ランド$$. Volunteering to team up with $n on your own right before the sortie.」

354:t_001:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「As his master, I figured I had to drill the smile into him out on the field!」

354:t_001:6.en:
$$甲児$$
($$ランド$$ seems to have noticed that $n is still torn, too.)

354:t_001:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
(He looks rowdy and overbearing, but he's actually pretty considerate.)

354:t_001:9.en:
$$メール$$
「You've still got a long way to go, $n. To get close to Darling's Heat Smile, you have to burn a lot hotter.」

354:t_001:11.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The girls in the $n fan club that quietly lurks at $$陣代高校$$ would break down crying.」

354:t_001:16.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You sure about that, $n? If you stop being the quiet type, those girls... might end up getting disillusioned instead.」

354:t_001:17.en:
$n
「In that case, I'll make them swoon with my new charm.」

354:t_001:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「Kind of a dated way to put it, though.」

354:t_001:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This guy... not just older women, but now he's finally sinking his fangs into high school girls...」

354:t_001:21.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Talk time is over. We're beginning the operation.」

354:t_001:22.en:
$$桂$$
「Well, looks like we'll have to thank $$クィーン$$-chan.」

354:t_001:23.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's too early to judge that.」

354:t_001:24.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The interception force has come out...!」

354:t_002:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$欲深な金牛$$, $$ストラウス$$...!」

354:t_002:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「I knew it, she was here after all...」

354:t_002:4.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$, did you sense that she was here?」

354:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah... And while we're at it, I've got a feeling I'm the one who has to take her on.」

354:t_002:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Empire's Supreme Commander is out on the edge of the $$地球圏$$...!」

354:t_002:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「She's brought $$ダバラーン$$ and a fleet with her.」
